aiVerification.summary: The workbook is citeable and comparable, but the draft contains malformed grouping and invalid extracted measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor overstates domains; evidence supports normal vs test VP mold conditions.
IR/lot and mold baselines are lumped without subgroup keys.
Several measurement outcomes are header-derived or nonsensical stats.
Tension test sample counts and extra stats are parsed incorrectly.
Decision rows are not integrated into outcomes or evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Should IR/lot be treated as a subgroup or separate comparison context?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to normal VP mold vs test VP mold condition.
Add subgroup keys for IR, mold number, process section, and test round if present.
Keep the four real outcome sections only: laser cutting, VP/CD vision, function, tension.
Remove header-derived and nonsensical measurement outcomes/stat rows.
Add decision rows as cited conclusion evidence without replacing row metrics.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Main row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient because many support invalid extracted outcomes.
